items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: He’s actually one of Woody’s musicians who wrote the chart.

ctx.x: Did you get some appreciative looks that day, in that situation?
Absolutely yeah. In fact the trombone player said, “Jesus Christ, how long ago did Bill send you that chart?” I said, “Bill didn’t send me the chart, I’m looking at it right now.”
Would that have been Bill Holman?
